about: Golden cases for docs/DOOMSDAY.md, shared by the addon (tests/spec/Doomsday_spec.lua) and the site. Never edit a case to make code pass: a rule change updates DOOMSDAY.md, this file and both copies in the same release. A case with `pool` is of that pool version; `huntSince` is the pool version the Hunt is drawn from (CF-104); the `draws.hunts` cases without `pool` pin the Hunt's rule as if it were drawn from pool version 1 (Vanilla's 20 combinations; pool version 5 draws from Forever's 23, CF-116; from pool version 6 the Hunt is race and class ids, Forever's 28 per faction with the Skyborne, CF-118); a case without it is of pool version 1. Cases marked addonOnly are the addon's (goal progress); the site may skip them.

pools.hunt: off until the pool version that verifies victim race and class (the cases under hunts are for that version)

realmOffset.note: realm still before midnight (west of UTC)
a minute of clock skew rounds to 15 min

schedule.note: realm midnight belongs to the day before
Saturday 18:59, last minute of the week

swaps.note: nothing to swap; the zone of the day from the highest character that played today
one level-15 character without professions: fallbacks, then the next goal in pool order
week: fallbacks, a fallback already taken moves on in pool order
pool version 2: a fallback outside the pool (d.groupFriend) is still taken; a secondary skill without the profession falls back
pool version 2 week: a fallback already taken moves on in pool version 2's order, past a goal that can't be done
pool version 3 day: p.homeGuard (level 20) swaps to its fallback p.loneWolf for a friend below 20
pool version 3 week: w.recipes3 without any profession and w.dungeons5 without a dungeon in range swap to their fallbacks
pool version 4 day: d.feedFriend swaps to its fallback d.trade for a friend without Cooking
pool version 4 day: d.fishFriend swaps to its fallback d.groupFriend for a friend without Fishing
pool version 4 day: p.frontLine (level 20) swaps to its fallback p.loneWolf for a friend below 20

scheduleCheck.note: a full day and a full week are kept as they are
the window: yesterday to 16 days ahead, last week to 3 weeks ahead
broken fields are dropped, the rest stays; a day left empty is dropped; unknown ids pass the check
only v: a valid, empty schedule (it clears an older one)
v not an integer: no schedule
days not a table: no schedule
CF-118: the optional fields of pool version 6 are kept: duel, hunt by the hunted faction (ids), pool, rare (duplicates dropped) and census
CF-118: a broken duel, a hunt target that isn't two ids, an unknown faction, a rare entry that isn't "race:class" and a census without a time are dropped; a day left with only its pool is dropped

scheduled.note: the day after a scheduled day keeps the normal draw, also a mission the scheduled day has
one slot: the others are the normal draw
an unknown id: that whole list is the normal draw; an unknown Skirmish too
a catalogue id that isn't in this pool version counts as unknown
a week with only the Bounty
swaps apply on top of the scheduled set
a day that already has a recorded set keeps it when a schedule arrives later
pool version 6: the Duel slot and both Hunts from the schedule (keyed by the hunted faction)
pool version 6: a check mission (Off) may be scheduled: the site switched it on
pool version 6: one faction's Hunt from the schedule, the other the draw's
pool version 6: no target (a Tauren Mage; an Orc listed as Alliance) and an unknown duel id: the draw's
pool version 6: a Skirmish id of the duel pool is not a Skirmish

kills.note: every band, a skull, unknown levels, solo, a community victim, the 4th kill of one victim that day, the next day, battleground kills on their own track. Results in time order.

duels.note: the first duel per pair and day counts once; both sides agree, disputed, one side only, strangers and own alts ignored, the next day again

progress.note: 4 counted kills in the zone of the day, 1 elsewhere
another character's death doesn't break it
a kill without a known class doesn't add one
a Shaman isn't on the Alliance list
pool version 5 (CF-116): a Dwarf Shaman makes the Shaman an Alliance class; 9 classes

points.note: PvE: 2 dailies + 1 weekly; PvP: Skirmish + Hunt + Bounty + kills + duels; an id from a newer pool counts nothing

pointsPerGoal.note: a day of pool version 1 (an entry without pool, no goals.pool): flat, 5 per daily, Skirmish and Hunt
a day of pool version 2: each goal's own size (1, 3 or 5); the Hunt stays 5
an entry without pool takes the friend's goals.pool
the entry's own pool wins over goals.pool: a day keeps the points of the pool it was drawn in
an unknown id (a newer pool) counts nothing in any pool version
a day of pool version 6: the Duel slot's mission by its size, p.duelFirst 0 (the duels score per pair)
pool version 6: a reused id scores its new size (p.kills10, 10 HKs: 5; p.duelWin: 3)

crown.note: crossed out = all 3 PvE dailies; the PvP goal doesn't count; the first by the last daily's time; equal times go to the lower friend key

streak.note: today counts once a goal is done
today without a goal yet doesn't end it
a missed day ends it; the best run stays
a stored best from days no longer kept

ladder.note: one ranking per track; PvE ties on goals then name; PvP Virgins aren't ranked; PvP ties on goals, then counted kills; movement since last week

CF-78: only a real fight (an honorable kill, a duel, a finished battleground: foughtEver) ranks on PvP; a friend with only PvP points from goals without a fight (emotes, the flag) stays a PvP Virgin with the points; foughtEver wins over the older killedEver, which is read when foughtEver is missing
